spiritreceived.comments:
You had lots of travel and the check was not always by defence if they were within 3 metres.
We could not hear the calls and you did not make any hand signals.
You always wanted to change our minds of you thoughts.

In our opinion even after talking to you in the halftime, none of our mentioned issues improved. You still made unnecessary calls and didn’t listen to us at all. We should have called a spirit timeout but we thought you would act upon our very clear feedback. The amount of calls that we had to contest because we couldn’t do anything else was unacceptable!
The spirit director has more feedback for you!

The game was really cool ! There were high intensity and clean defenses. Good luck for the next game !

SD director note - FRA mixed came to me to discuss score. Actually should be a 1 for attitude and self control, not a 3. Cannot change the score but noted comments. Positive attitude and self-control was poor because FRA felt that some of the calls were unnecessary or not good, and the discussion was too long because SGP did not want to retract or contest the call. Otherwise it was a good match.

The game was an intense battle but well spirited and all players were respectful throughout. There were a lot of repeated pick and travel calls; although uncontested, it would be appreciated to try and avoid these scenarios. Overall, a positive and skilled team to play against.
